extra.summary: DBS Woman’s Card is one of the best ladies’ rewards credit cards in Singapore for shopping. DBS rewards points earned expire in a year, and can be redeemed for cashback, Fairprice vouchers, Apple AirPods, and more. Other benefits include annual fee waiver, fashion, beauty, and hotel deals and promotions.

annual-interest-rate-and-fees.Annual Interest Rate: 27.80% p.a. chargeable on daily basis (subject to compounding)

our_takes.our-take: The DBS Woman's Card rewards online spending (5X points per S$5, capped at S$1,000/month), which translates to 2 miles per dollar – useful if you spend heavily online on things like e-commerce, health, or beauty. While it offers first-year fee waiver, be mindful of the S$163.50 annual fee thereafter. Consider if your monthly online spending justifies the ongoing cost. Note that certain transaction types are excluded and interest is high at 27.8% if you don't pay in full. This card suits those who actively track and redeem rewards points earned from online shopping.
our_takes.good-for:
* Online shoppers seeking accelerated rewards on everyday e-commerce purchases, up to S$1,000 per month.
* Those who want to earn rewards points for online transactions, redeemable for shopping and other lifestyle perks.
* Young professionals who appreciate e-commerce protection and a first-year annual fee waiver on a rewards card.
our_takes.things-to-note:
* A 27.80% annual interest rate applies if you carry a balance, increasing your debt quickly.
* Late payment fees of S$100 apply for balances over S$200, so pay promptly.
* Points exclude certain MCCs and transactions, limiting reward earning opportunities on some purchases.
